# Worldclass Bengal Fishers

> Worldclass Bengal Fishers (WBF) is a Bangladesh-based buyer's broker for seafood and food. Its mission is to be the best broker in the world for food importers. We match importers worldwide with licensed Bangladeshi exporters, verify plant approvals (DoF FIQC, EU, SFDA, GACC, US FDA) and lab results, and manage quotes, inspection, documents and reefer or air shipment.

Key facts
- Network: 148 registered Bangladeshi seafood exporters mapped across 17 districts (EPB directory); 54 on our shortlist, 19 rated Priority A.
- Products: 103 export lines (63 seafood, 40 food).
- Terms: FOB Chattogram, CFR or CIF; air freight from Dhaka for live and chilled products. Quotes within 24 hours.
- Minimum order: usually one 20-foot reefer per product.

Pages
- [Product directory](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/products.html): every product with scientific name, Bangla name, HS heading, forms and main markets
- [Bangladesh export guide](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/guide.html): exporters by district, HS codes, licences and approvals, hilsa rules, associations, shipping
- [Supplier network](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/sourcing.html): how suppliers are rated; exporters can apply to join
- [Quality](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/quality.html): lab testing per lot and the cold chain
- [Markets & logistics](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/markets.html): transit times, load planner, ordering steps
- [Request a quote](https://www.worldclassbengalfishers.com/contact.html)

Product directory
- Shrimp & prawn: Black tiger shrimp, Giant freshwater prawn, Whiteleg shrimp, Indian white shrimp, Speckled (brown) shrimp, Small freshwater shrimp, Value-added shrimp
- Crab, lobster & molluscs: Mud crab, Soft-shell crab, Spiny lobster, Squid, Cuttlefish, Octopus
- Marine finfish: Hilsa, Kelee shad, Silver pomfret, Chinese pomfret, Black pomfret, Ribbonfish, Bombay duck, Pama croaker, Indian threadfin, Fourfinger threadfin, Indo-Pacific king mackerel, Indian mackerel, Red snapper, Grouper, Barramundi (Asian sea bass), Mullet, Yellowfin seabream, Grunt, Tuna (skipjack, yellowfin), Barracuda, Tripletail
- Freshwater & farmed fish: Pangasius, Tilapia, Rohu, Catla, Mrigal, Kalbasu, Silver carp, Climbing perch, Stinging catfish, Walking catfish, Striped snakehead, Giant snakehead, Wallago catfish, Long-whiskered catfish, Pabda catfish, Gulsha tengra, Tengra catfish, Clown knifefish, Mola carplet, Puti barb
- Live eel & specialty: Mud eel
- Dried, salted & by-products: Dried Bombay duck, Dried ribbonfish, Dried shrimp, Mixed dried sea fish, Salted hilsa, Fish maw (swim bladder), Fish scales, Fish oil
- Rice & grains: Aromatic rice (Kalijira, Chinigura, Kataribhog), Puffed rice, Flattened rice, Vermicelli & laccha semai
- Spices, tea & leaf: Turmeric, Dried red chilli, Coriander, Black cumin (nigella), Tea, Betel leaf
- Fresh vegetables: Potato, Pointed gourd, Teasel gourd, Bitter gourd, Bottle gourd, Okra, Brinjal (aubergine), Yard-long bean, Taro & arum, Green chilli, Leafy greens, Shatkora citrus
- Fresh fruits: Mango (Himsagar, Langra, Amrapali, Fazli), Jackfruit, Pineapple, Lychee, Guava
- Frozen & ready-to-cook: Frozen vegetables, Frozen paratha, Frozen snacks (samosa, singara, spring roll)
- Processed & packaged foods: Biscuits & bakery, Instant noodles, Snacks (chanachur, chips), Fruit juices & drinks, Pickles & chutneys, Sauces & ketchup, Spice mixes (masala), Mustard oil, Honey (Sundarbans, mustard), Date-palm jaggery
